name: Disguise Multi Transport Control

options.label: Transport (Player)
options.description: Select a target transport. List is updated by polling.
options.choicesNote: Transports (players) reported by the Multitransport Manager: id and label are both the player name, refreshed by polling {"query":{"q":"playerList"}} (src/main.js:278-296). Until a list has been received the only entry is {id "", label "No transports loaded"} and the action logs an error and sends nothing for an empty id. The default is computed at runtime ((self.playerList && self.playerList.length > 0) ? self.playerList[0].id : '') and is not recorded.

notes: Complete list: 2 actions (go_to_cue, transport_command), both registered in actions.js; the module defines no feedbacks (there is no setFeedbackDefinitions call).

Protocol: TCP socket, one JSON object per line (newline terminated), for the disguise Multitransport Controller (default port 54321 in src/main.js getConfigFields). Commands are {"track_command":{...}}. The module polls playerList and trackList every pollingInterval seconds (default 5, 0 disables polling) and rebuilds the actions when the lists change.
The transport, track and transitionTrack dropdowns take their choices from the polled lists when the actions are (re)registered; defaults are the first list entry, so they are not recorded.
Play-mode ids are the strings play, playSection, loop and stop; go_to_cue offers only the first three (PLAY_MODES.slice(0, 3), actions.js:11-14).

The location field accepts a cue number (1, 1.2 or 1.2.3), sent as "CUE <number>", or a timecode HH:MM:SS:FF; the field regex is recorded as written. The transition time is sent as a string; with "Use Track Transition" the transition track and section are sent instead.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.11.3: options do not support expressions.
Status read, not verified-sample: the module has only two actions, so fewer than five entries could be compared by hand (both were compared option by option).
